analysis.reason:

5일간의 가격 흐름에서 5일 저가($1619.34)가 20일 저가($1619.34)보다 높게 형성되며 Higher Low 패턴의 시작을 시사.

analysis.reasonEn:
RSI rose from 43.4 to 48.3, confirming exit from oversold territory.
The 5-day low ($1619.34) formed higher than the 20-day low ($1619.34), suggesting the start of a Higher Low pattern.
The weekly ADX at 30.2 indicates a clear trend is maintained, and the current price ($1714.88) is above the weekly SMA20 ($1694.02).
